data_fields.name: incoming_queue_length
data_fields.donor_constant: 16384 requests per client, then disconnect (close reason too many requests)

best_idea: Per tick, evaluate each distinct view once (dedupe by query), emit only the net inserts and deletes of rows a viewer can see, encode them once, and fan the same bytes out to every viewer.
decision_why: Keep the shape (one evaluation per distinct view, net enter and leave events, one encode, one fan-out) and drop bag semantics for HP and kills, which are one-count facts. Pair it with a bounded outbound queue and a written shedding rule, since the donor has no outbound bound.
acceptance: Server test: with 3 viewers of one fight, the view is computed once per tick and encoded once (counter = 1) and each viewer gets the same bytes; an entity spawned and removed in the same tick sends no add and no remove; a tick with no change for a view sends nothing to that view's viewers; a viewer whose outbound queue is full is dropped by the stated rule, not by blocking the tick.
